limitations: This records document-level routing judgments, not runtime execution or performance.
Specific model IDs, effort levels, account/payment mode, rates, counters, and cost inputs are absent from the case facts. No exact forecast or model assignment is claimed.
The stated worker availability and capability facts are scenario inputs, not independently verified runtime availability.
These observations are not new oracles and were not used to retune expected outputs.

cases.raw_case_facts: Whole user goal: correct one word in known plaintext. Source is available. Primary is capable. Narrow diff verification. No other work.
cases.who_executes: Primary agent performs the one-word correction and its narrow acceptance check.
next_allowed_actions: Make the bounded correction after assessing the whole goal.
Inspect the diff and perform the stated narrow verification.
unknowns: The primary model ID and effort are not supplied, so they cannot be recorded as actual values.
No worker configuration, prices, or cost advantage is supplied; optional delegation has no supported cost advantage here.
cases.basis: The whole goal is short and self-contained, capability is adequate, context is bounded, and the local correction plus focused check are supporting actions within one task.

cases.raw_case_facts: Whole user goal: one coherent feature requiring investigation of events, contract update, implementation, and integration checks, with substantial expected logs/context. Primary is capable. A worker is available. Budget allows.
cases.who_executes: A worker owns the coherent feature slice, including its investigation, contract update, implementation, and integration checks. Primary retains coordination and final acceptance.
next_allowed_actions: Before the worker starts, use the router to select a supported model and effort and forecast cost through acceptance.
Give the worker the whole coherent slice, its scope, dependencies, permissions, and acceptance criteria.
Primary accepts the result against the stable contract and evidence.
unknowns: Primary and worker model IDs, effort, payment mode, rates, token estimates, and numeric budget are not supplied. The scenario says the budget allows, but an exact forecast cannot be reconstructed.
No worker start or underlying feature work was performed in this trial.
cases.basis: The expected investigation, contract, implementation, and integration stages plus substantial logs/context require delegation before full research. A single coherent slice may stay with one worker; primary capability and the fact that there is only one result do not remove the context gate.

cases.raw_case_facts: One required slice is beyond primary configuration capability and within an available worker configuration. The child costs more and handoff overhead exists. Budget allows.
cases.who_executes: An adequate worker executes the capability-gap slice; primary remains manager and acceptance owner.
next_allowed_actions: Use the router to confirm a supported adequate worker configuration and forecast the full slice through acceptance.
Assign the slice with a verified handoff and acceptance criteria.
unknowns: Exact model IDs, effort, rate basis, cost, and budget amounts are not supplied.
No worker start or underlying slice execution was performed in this trial.
cases.basis: A known primary capability gap makes delegation mandatory for even one coherent slice. Higher child cost and handoff overhead cannot justify substituting an inadequate primary configuration. Cost and budget still require a forecast before a real start.

cases.raw_case_facts: Same long, context-heavy feature chain as B. No workers are available. Primary has capacity. External user permissions are unchanged.
cases.who_executes: No one may execute the dependent feature work under the stated conditions. Primary remains coordinator and must report the blocker.
next_allowed_actions: Record worker unavailability as a blocker and stop dependent investigation, contract changes, implementation, and integration work.
Continue only work that is independently authorized and does not substitute for the blocked delegated slice.
blocked_work_or_permissions: Do not silently switch to primary-only because the primary has capacity.
Do not change external user permissions or expand authorization to remove the blocker.
unknowns: The case does not identify any independent authorized work that can advance without the feature slice.
Model, effort, rates, and forecast inputs remain unspecified.
cases.basis: The B context/stage gate still requires delegation. The manager's blocker rule forbids substituting primary execution or changing authorization.

cases.raw_case_facts: Whole user goal: tiny known bug fix in one function. An existing focused regression is available. A local patch and check fit bounded primary context. Primary is capable.
cases.who_executes: Primary performs the local fix and runs the existing focused regression as the acceptance check.
next_allowed_actions: Inspect the relevant function and its direct contract.
Apply the local fix and run the existing focused regression.
Inspect the diff and report the check result.
unknowns: Primary model ID and effort are not supplied.
No supported cost advantage for optional delegation is stated.
cases.basis: A short local correction with its focused check is explicitly treated as one short goal, not a series of substantive stages.

cases.raw_case_facts: User asks for plan only: a large dependency map requiring broad source investigation. No source edits or actual checks are authorized. A worker is available.
cases.who_executes: A worker can investigate and prepare the plan/dependency map within the plan-only scope. Primary coordinates and accepts the plan.
next_allowed_actions: Use the router before full investigation to select a supported configuration and forecast the planning work through acceptance.
Assign read-only source investigation and plan preparation with exact scope and plan acceptance criteria.
Keep the output at planning level; do not edit source or run project checks.
blocked_work_or_permissions: Source edits and actual project checks remain outside the user's plan-only authorization.
unknowns: Specific model IDs, effort, rates, payment mode, budget, and estimated context are absent, so no exact forecast is available.
The case states that a worker is available but does not state which worker configuration is supported.
cases.basis: The plan requires broad source investigation and substantial context, which invokes the delegation gate before full research. Plan-only limits the work product and permissions; it does not remove the context gate.

cases.raw_case_facts: A selected delegate owns one substantial coherent slice. The worker completed its first stage and must continue the same original context/result. Domain and review role do not change.
cases.who_executes: The same worker continues the original slice in the same context. Primary continues coordination and acceptance ownership.
next_allowed_actions: Verify that slice ID, result contract, acceptance criteria, scope, project, role, permissions, ownership, and artifact purpose still match.
Provide current revisions and relevant changes, then use a follow-up for the original slice.
Use a new worker with a short verified handoff only if a required identity or context condition changes, or if a necessary configuration change cannot be made through follow-up.
blocked_work_or_permissions: Do not repurpose the completed worker for an unrelated slice or independent review through follow-up.
Do not change the domain, result, role, or permissions through a task-bearing follow-up.
unknowns: Current artifact revisions and any material changes must be supplied before the continuation message; the scenario does not list them.
No continuation message or worker operation was performed in this trial.
cases.basis: The manager permits reuse only within the worker's original slice and requires the original identity and purpose to remain stable. The supplied facts preserve them, so same-context follow-up is the allowed continuation route.
